title: Professional Business Communication
quote: I thought the online course was very interactive considering the circumstances. We was still all able to have a discussion and answer questions. I had a few technical difficulties but it soon resolved itself. We weren't able to finish the course in one session due to the technical difficulties but we all agreed we wouldn't mind doing the second half of the session in the near future. Martin is a good trainer, he likes to get everyone involved and to give their points of view. I look forward to the next half of the session.
author: Rebecca Bobbett
subject: Professional Business Communication
